title: Advanced: chains, critique loops and system prompts
summary: Multi-step workflows, self-critique and reusable instructions for heavier projects such as dissertations.

lessons.title: Chains and critique loops
lessons.body: Split a big task into stages and feed each result into the next. Add a critique step: ask the model to list weaknesses in its own answer, then revise. You stay the judge.

lessons.title: Reusable instructions
lessons.body: Write a standing instruction block (role, rules, format, what to refuse) you paste at the start of a session. Keep it short and test it.

exercises.title: Plan a dissertation chain
exercises.scenario: You have a 10,000 word dissertation and 12 weeks.
exercises.task: Write a prompt that sets up a staged workflow, not one giant request.

checks.label: Includes a checkpoint for you
checks.hint: Make it pause for your approval.

exercises.model_answer_tip: 'We will work in stages on my 12 week, 10,000 word dissertation. Stage 1: ask me five questions to narrow my topic. Then wait for me before moving on. Stage 2: help me outline chapters.'

exercises.title: Add a critique loop
exercises.scenario: You asked for a literature summary and want it checked.
exercises.task: Ask the model to critique its own answer, then improve it.

checks.label: Asks for self-critique
checks.hint: Ask it to critique its own answer.

checks.label: Asks to flag uncertainty
checks.hint: Ask it to flag what I must verify.

exercises.model_answer_tip: 'Summarise the main debates on X in 150 words. Then critique your own summary: list weaknesses and anything I must verify. Then revise it.'

exercises.title: Write a standing instruction block
exercises.scenario: You use AI for study every week and keep re-typing the rules.
exercises.task: Write a short reusable instruction block.

checks.label: Sets rules
checks.hint: Add rules with always or never.

checks.label: Protects integrity
checks.hint: Make it a coach, not a ghost-writer.

checks.label: Sets format
checks.hint: Say how long or what format.

exercises.model_answer_tip: 'You are my study coach. Always explain, never write assessed work for me, give hints first, keep answers under 150 words in bullet points, and tell me when you are unsure.'
